patch_description: Replace repeated selection of the single currently worst triangle with probabilistic sampling from a low-area active set. Maximin optima are governed by several nearly tight triangle constraints; always moving only the unique worst triangle tends to oscillate between a few constraints. Sampling low-area triangles with inverse-area weights retains strong pressure on bottlenecks while allowing the search to resolve competing active constraints. The discovery stage uses a narrow active set and the longer refinement stage uses a broader one.
